music.prompt: Instrumental sci-fi lounge background music for a calm futuristic reception at the top of a clock tower overlooking a neon city at night. Downtempo, 92 BPM, warm analog synth pads, soft Rhodes electric piano chords, gentle arpeggiated synth, deep round sub bass, brushed electronic drums with subtle shuffle, light vinyl texture, dreamy and optimistic, Blade Runner meets bossa nova lounge. Even energy all the way through with no big build-ups, no vocals, no sudden stops, so it works as unobtrusive looping background music. End softly so it can loop back to the start.
